recommended_successor.first_stage: prospective protocol and observability contract before implementation or training

scientific_question: Why did the v0.31 calibrated utility-learning pathway fail to produce a discriminative intervention signal?
scientific_synthesis: The v0.31 utility selector did not learn a sufficiently variable decision signal. Its utility output remained tightly concentrated near the neutral initialization across the frozen validation conditions.
The selector did not discriminate class-preserving mismatch from matched evidence, nor catastrophic from clean evidence, under the prospectively frozen discrimination rule.
The intervention mechanism remained inactive across clean, graded, and catastrophic strata, with zero active intervention rate in all three.
Within the admissible v0.32 evidence, the failure is therefore characterized as selector optimization failure.

This attribution is mechanism-level but not fully causal: the frozen v0.31 artifacts did not record delta_u, u_target, p_ref_true, p_candidate_true, utility-loss trajectories, utility-head parameter movement, or gradient diagnostics.
Consequently, v0.32 cannot determine whether weak candidate actions, weak utility targets, target-transform compression, or another upstream process caused the selector optimization failure.
successor_design_constraints: Any successor must use a new prospectively frozen version and must not modify or reopen v0.31 or v0.32.

Before training a successor utility selector, the implementation must record the counterfactual utility supervision needed to distinguish target-signal, candidate-action, transform-compression, and optimization failures.

The successor protocol should require persistent diagnostics for delta_u, u_target, p_ref_true, p_candidate_true, utility loss, utility output distribution, selector parameter movement, and gradient or equivalent optimization-signal diagnostics.
A real one-batch training-path regression should verify that the selector receives non-zero optimization signal when non-neutral utility targets are present.
The intervention gate should remain inactive-by-default until a prospectively specified evidence-to-utility learning criterion is satisfied.
No threshold search or intervention redesign may be justified using the official test split.
what_v032_does_not_establish: a unique causal origin of the selector optimization failure
any new robustness or performance claim
what_v032_establishes: final utility signal non-learning under the frozen Q4 rule
final utility signal non-discrimination under the frozen Q5 rule
zero intervention activation across clean, graded, and catastrophic quality strata
selector_optimization_failure as the admissible constrained failure attribution
